name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Resizable panels (react-resizable-panels v4). The handle is a 2px ink line: hover thickens it by 1px per side, focus draws the focus ring, and a grip (withHandle) is a small 2px-framed box that turns to an ink flat while dragging. The hit area is 24px wide (44px under 640 px). Put the group inside a case (ink-case) to frame the panels.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/resizable". The group and panel are your own shadcn parts; the handle is drawn here on the same react-resizable-panels Separator, because the stock handle classes would fight the 2px line. Panel sizes are numbers in pixels, or strings for percentages (defaultSize="60").

meta.tagline: Panels divided by a 2px ink line with a grip to pull.
meta.usage:
import { ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup } from "@/components/ui/manga/resizable"

<ResizablePanelGroup orientation="horizontal" className="ink-case relative h-80">
  <ResizablePanel defaultSize="60">Page</ResizablePanel>
  <ResizableHandle withHandle />
  <ResizablePanel defaultSize="40">Notes</ResizablePanel>
</ResizablePanelGroup>

props.name: withHandle
props.description: On ResizableHandle: draws the grip (a small 2px-framed box with two ink lines).
